# E002 -- MICA Brand Guidelines (Pentagram)

## Metadata
- **Source:** 2016-09-13_mica_guidelines_pentagram-pdf.pdf
- **Brand:** MICA (Maryland Institute College of Art)
- **Industry:** Education / Art School
- **Year:** 2016
- **Designer:** Pentagram
- **Pages Sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13
- **Total Pages:** 88
- **Document Type:** Graphic Identity Standards and Guidelines

## Brand Strategy
- Comprehensive identity system for an art college, designed by Pentagram
- System built around three core elements: Logo, Signature (full institution name), and Lock-ups (defined Logo+Signature configurations)
- Emphasis on consistency, integrity, and controlled flexibility across scales

## Logo
- Logo is the core typographic identifier; can be used independently
- 5 Secondary Lock-up variants for different spatial requirements
- Three scale versions per lock-up: Large (cap height >1/2"), Regular (1/16"-1/2"), Small (1/16"-3/64")
- Minimum size: Signature height never below 3/64"
- Custom-drawn forms at each scale for maximum legibility -- must use supplied files, never recreate
- Detailed clearspace rules (pages 25-26)
- Integrity rules prohibiting modification (pages 28-29)

## Typography
- **Logo typeface:** Giza (custom/display)
- **Supporting typeface:** Theinhardt (sans-serif)
- **System typefaces:** Times and Arial (fallbacks)

## Color
- Color palette with "inspiration" context (page 16)
- Defined color ratio system (page 18)
- Monochrome and vibrant usage modes (pages 19-20)
- Color integrated with identity elements (page 21)
- Expanded visual vocabulary through color (page 22)

## Graphics / Iconography
- Two pattern systems: Organic pattern (with optional shadow variant) and Linear pattern (with optional logo integration)
- "Logo slashes" graphic element -- derived from the logo form
- Seal element for formal/institutional use

## Photography
- Identity and imagery guidelines (page 27) -- not sampled in detail

## Applications
- Extensive application suite (pages 43-85): letterhead (general, department, board of trustees, president), envelopes, business cards, monarch stationery, mailing labels, email signatures, presentation slides
- Inspiration section: brochures, t-shirts, postcards, mugs, tote bags, publications, pocket folders
- File naming convention specified: e.g. MICA_SecondaryLockUp1_RegularScale_Black.eps

## Tone of Voice
- Not explicitly covered in sampled pages; guide is design/visual-focused

## Outliers / Unique Elements
- Extremely detailed scaling system with three optical sizes (Large/Regular/Small) custom-drawn for legibility -- uncommon level of craft
- Pattern systems (organic and linear) provide a distinctive visual language beyond the logo
- "Logo slashes" as an independent graphic device
- Pentagram-level production quality; strict file-based asset management

## Quality Score
5 / 5
- Exceptionally thorough 88-page guide covering identity system, color, typography, patterns, and extensive applications
- Pentagram craft quality with custom-drawn optical sizes and detailed lock-up variants
- Strong structural organization with clear TOC and systematic approach
